data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day as a standard action, you can summon a shield archon (Bestiary 2 p.31). The shield archon follows your commands perfectly for %1 minutes before vanishing back to its home in Heaven. The shield archon doesn't follow commands that would violate its alignment, however, and particularly egregious commands could cause it to attack you.|TL
